prose: Bloomberg reports a wave of Google DeepMind researchers leaving to found their own AI startups, many chasing alternatives to large language models. At a London breakfast this month, 15 DeepMind employees and alumni compared notes - a snapshot of how much talent is in motion. (The article is paywalled; this summary is based on the feed excerpt.)
highlights: A wave of DeepMind researchers has left recently to launch AI startups
Many of the new ventures focus on alternatives to LLMs
15 DeepMind employees and alumni met for a London breakfast this month
Summary based on the feed excerpt; the Bloomberg original is paywalled
